name: Pretty Please
source:
A short game about a lady who goes into a beauty clinic to "fix a few things". Features several endings and beautiful artwork, made for GameZanga gamejam.

[From [url=https://stanza.itch.io/pretty-please]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款关于女士前往美容诊所“修整几处问题”的短篇游戏。收录多个结局与精美画面，为GameZanga游戏创作马拉松制作。

[来源：[url=https://stanza.itch.io/pretty-please]itch.io[/url]]
